lines:
Implemented and critically audited the formal concurrent Chat design after investigating DeepSeek Harness first. Native commands own immutable Chat-bound workers and release the coordinator during effects. History/session metadata writes use short shared locks; per-Chat reservations and cancellation isolate activity. Worker Settings feedback merges into current documents. All live model/tool/approval dispatches use invocation-specific delivery, preventing a sibling active dispatch from being classified as abandoned. UI permits history/New Chat throughout work and recovery, shows busy icons, preserves Chat drafts/pending/errors/maintenance queues, captures command targets, and fences navigation plus overtaken snapshots without dropping live events. Delete/fork guards apply to their target. Updated legacy UI tests that encoded the old global recovery lock.

Verification: cargo test --manifest-path desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib runtime::: 325 passed; targeted frontend suite: 58 passed; changed recovery and concurrency tests rerun: 38 passed. npm run check, npm run build, cargo check --tests, cargo build, and git diff --check passed. Final real native WebView/IPC test passed using two simultaneously held SSE requests: both busy icons, New Chat/history navigation, Stop A while B stays active, draft restoration, concurrent Settings preservation, isolated transcript events, background completion preserving selection, and restart recovery without replay while a new Chat runs. Evidence: desktop/src-tauri/target/native-concurrency-1789465424061/result.json, two-chats-running.png, completed-chat.png, requests.json. Reproduction and architecture notes: docs/chat-concurrency.md.

Existing boundary: the synchronous provider parser observes cancellation between reads; the SSE fixture keeps connections alive with heartbeats. Immediate interruption of a silent provider socket is not introduced here. Drafts persist across navigation within the workspace lifetime. Existing dead-code/bundle warnings remain. Pre-existing and concurrent Settings/default-selection edits were preserved. The debug executable is rebuilt; no installer deployment or commit was performed. Task is finished for review, not closed.

data.description: Implement concurrent Chat design (uml.chat.concurrent_execution) and the invocation broker ownership rule added during native verification, formal design revisions 587–591. Reference: DeepSeek core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts owns a driver/inbox/AbortController per SessionId; api/session-controller/src/client/sessions/manager.ts separates selection from resident sessions; ui-workspace/src/client/rows/Rows.tsx keeps running rows clickable. Replace Aworkit's full-command global mutex and selection-dependent committer with immutable Chat-bound workers, per-Chat reservation/cancellation, short shared metadata locks and coordinator-only Settings feedback. Live model/tool dispatch must deliver and reconcile only its own invocation; sibling DispatchAttempted records are active work. Route commands/snapshots explicitly, fence navigation and out-of-order responses, preserve live events, Chat drafts, pending/error/maintenance queues, and show accessible busy history icons. Preserve frozen authority and idempotent recovery. Acceptance: overlapping actual native provider calls; New Chat/history/Settings responsive; Stop, drafts, events, approvals and recovery remain with their owner; background completion preserves selection; busy target delete/fork rejected; targeted Rust/UI tests and native WebView proof. Preserve pre-existing worktree changes.
data.title: Enable independent concurrent Chats and nonblocking navigation
